english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a communicative body or hand gesture.
Use this when the flourish is a visible dramatic gesture, such as waving a flag, rather than a decoration.
Use 手勢 for the hand gesture itself when someone waves to signal, dismiss, or attract attention.

examples.english: You gesture for me to come over.
examples.jyutping: nei5 daa2 go3 sau2 sai3 giu3 ngo5 gwo3 heoi3

examples.english: They made a dramatic flourish with their hands at the most exciting part.
examples.traditional: 佢講到最緊張嗰句，突然做咗個誇張手勢。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 gong2 dou3 zeoi3 gan2 zoeng1 go2 geoi3 dat6 jin4 zou6 zo2 go3 kwaa1 zoeng1 sau2 sai3

examples.english: They used a hand gesture to wave me over.
